title: Mergers produce heavy elements like gold and platinum.
purpose: Explain nucleosynthesis in neutron star collisions.
narration: Deep in the universe, when two neutron stars merge, they create extreme conditions that forge the heaviest elements, including gold and platinum. This process, called nucleosynthesis, is responsible for the presence of these precious metals throughout the cosmos.

claims.text: When two neutron stars merge, they create extreme conditions that forge the heaviest elements.
These cosmic collisions produce gold and platinum.
This process is called nucleosynthesis and is responsible for the presence of these elements throughout the cosmos.
